First tagged release of OmniBeam, the browser app live at https://omnibeam.site.

- Send files of any size between iPhone, Android, Windows, Mac, Linux and Chromebook, peer to peer over WebRTC, encrypted end to end
- Pair once with a 6-digit code or QR code to find your devices on any network
- Share by link, request files, event photo album, chat, TV mode, phone as webcam, folder sync and photo backup
- 15 languages, installable as an app; Chrome, Firefox and Microsoft Store versions; `npx omnibeam` for the terminal
- Self-host: `node server.js`, no dependencies to install (see the README)
